COMPREHENSIVE REPORT ON THE STATUS OF THE COMPLETION
WHEREAS, the long planned 26th Street storm sewer interceptor project from O'Neil
Avenue to Capitol Avenue is thefinal phase of a comprehensive infrastructure upgrade to protect
the health, safety and property in the Original City portion of the City of Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, immediate flood protection of the Wyoming State Capitol and the Hersch ler
Building is a critical need as the 300 million dollar Capitol Square project nears completion; and
WHEREAS, the 26"h Street storm sewer interceptor will convey storm water to Crow
Creek, awayfrom the heart of downtown Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, the City Councilis currently evaluating funding mechanisms for a number
of projects, including the reconstruction of Evers Boulevard, the Christensen Road overpass and
the new Municipal Court building, and accurate and up to date financial projections are an
immediate need.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that Amy Allen, City Engineer, and Ron Downey, City
Treasurer, are hereby directed to consult within two(2)weeks of the adoption of this resolution
with Wyoming Special Assistant Attorney General Mike O'Donnell, and deliver to the
Governing Body a comprehensive written report detailing the steps necessary to fund, finalize
design, bid and construct the 26"h Street storm sewer interceptor from O'Neil Avenue to Capitol
Avenue during the calendar year2019.
PRESENTED, READ AND ADOPTED this
day of
